Why choose an independent pharmacy

Treated like family, not a number

Stone Plaza Pharmacy has served the Stone Lake and North Main Street neighborhoods since 2007. Being independent means we answer to you, not a corporate office.

  • We know you by name

    We take the time to understand your health needs and preferences, and tailor our advice to you.

  • Quick, reliable service

    Your time matters. We fill prescriptions efficiently without cutting corners on care.

  • Care that is coordinated

    We work directly with your doctors when something needs sorting out.

  • Experienced, friendly staff

    Decades of experience and a team that is always ready to answer your questions.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Still wondering about something? Call 864-233-7940 and ask a pharmacist.

How do I transfer my prescriptions to Stone Plaza?

Send us your name, date of birth, your current pharmacy and the medications you take using the form below, or just call. We contact your old pharmacy and move everything over, so there is no gap in your medication.

How do I request a refill?

Use the refill form on this page or call us. Have your prescription number handy if you can. We will let you know when it is ready for pickup or delivery.

Do you deliver?

Yes. We offer local delivery across the Greenville area. Ask about delivery when you request a refill.

Which insurance plans do you accept?

Call us with your insurance card in hand and we will confirm your coverage. [Add the list of accepted plans.]

What makes an independent pharmacy different?

We take the time to get to know you, your health needs and your preferences. That means shorter waits, a pharmacist who picks up the phone, and care tailored to you rather than a corporate script.

How long has Stone Plaza Pharmacy been open?

We have been family-owned and serving Greenville since 2007.
